nodes.label: .aoimage snapshot
nodes.rationale: Function pointers not stored; NativeMethod rebound by symbol name on load

nodes.label: Blue Book compliance
nodes.rationale: Language semantics and object model from Blue Book; 16-bit OOP and BitBlt GUI not reproduced

nodes.label: C ABI runtime-app boundary
nodes.rationale: Only bridge/ao_abi.h crosses runtime and Swift app; Swift must not depend on C++ templates

nodes.label: Kernel methods are NativeMethod
nodes.rationale: Kernel category classes and methods must all be native C++ code; Smalltalk sources in image/Kernel are comments and protocol only

nodes.label: 64-bit tagged OOP
nodes.rationale: No object table; direct tagged pointers for SmallInteger, Character, immediates, and heap objects

nodes.label: Vendor class library import
nodes.rationale: Do not invent class libraries; import Cuis/Squeak .st with minimal patches

nodes.label: No copy of existing Smalltalk VMs
